# Egor Matafonov — Product Manager

> A bilingual portfolio featuring TaskFocus, MindTrack, CortexMap and Telegram Growth Analytics.

## Portfolio
- [Portfolio home](https://simifar.github.io/porfolio.site/)

## Projects
- [TaskFocus](https://github.com/Simifar/taskfocus): task planner with a daily list limited to five tasks.
- [MindTrack](https://simifar.github.io/mindtrack/): browser app for self-observation with questionnaires; answers stay in browser storage. [Source](https://github.com/Simifar/mindtrack)
- [CortexMap](https://simifar.github.io/CortexMap/): Russian-language catalog for learning English, with CEFR levels, search and filters. [Source](https://github.com/Simifar/CortexMap)
- [Telegram Growth Analytics](https://github.com/Simifar/StatsTelegramChannels): desktop tool for reviewing ads in public Telegram channels; results are stored locally.
